summary: State Street filed an 8-K on August 7, 2026, reporting an underwritten public offering of 500,000 depositary shares, each representing a 1/100th interest in a new Fixed Rate Reset Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, Series L, with $100,000 liquidation preference. Articles of Amendment were filed August 6, 2026. Underwriting agreement with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley on August 5, 2026, under an S-3 shelf. This preferred issuance raises capital but is not a special situation such as an acquisition or activist campaign; it is a routine corporate financing event, though the proceeds may support capital actions.
